paragraphs: A digital wedding invitation built with Next.js (App Router), Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion. No database, no backend, no environment variables, so it hosts free on Vercel.
One dark-brown, gold-text invitation. Six pages, shown one at a time. One scroll, swipe or key press: the old page fades out slowly, then the new page fades in.

A page taller than the screen scrolls inside itself first; one more scroll at its end moves to the next page. The invitation can also turn its own pages (auto-play), starting 3 seconds after it loads, until a guest clicks, taps or scrolls.
features: Cover (full screen): Khmer title, crest, the guest's name, and an Open invitation button (it also starts the music).
"The wedding of" (full screen): the couple, Khmer names large with the English name below each, every name on one line.
The invitation: parents, the invitation text, groom on the left and bride on the right with a round photo slot under each name, then date and place.
Program and location: the two-day program with a gold timeline, beside the map or your QR code.
